session.zh: 跨市场收盘 · 美国 / 香港 9 月 15 日
session.en: Cross-market close · US / Hong Kong Sep 15

headline.zh: 油价与长端利率继续抬升折现率压力；美港股走弱，Apple 启动 Siri AI beta，DRAM 现货温和分化。
headline.en: Oil and long yields sustained discount-rate pressure; US and Hong Kong equities weakened as Apple began the Siri AI beta and DRAM spot pricing stayed selective.

summary.zh: 截至上海时间 9 月 16 日早晨，9 月 15 日是美港最近完整交易日。标普 500 下跌 0.4% 至 7,585.73，纳指下跌 0.8% 至 25,981.57；恒指下跌约 1.0% 至 24,667，恒生科技指数下跌 0.6%。AP 报道布伦特原油收于每桶 108.75 美元（+2.9%），美国 10 年期国债收益率升至 5.00%、隔夜一度触及 5.04%。Apple 已推出新一代 Apple Intelligence 与 Siri AI，英语 beta 当日开始推送；中国暂不可用，部分地区的初始可用性也受限。TrendForce 的 9 月 15 日现货报价显示 DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 上涨 0.12% 至 54.40 美元，DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 下跌 0.08% 至 45.536 美元，DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 下跌 0.14% 至 89.125 美元。
summary.en: As of the morning of September 16 in Shanghai, September 15 was the latest completed US and Hong Kong session. The S&P 500 fell 0.4% to 7,585.73 and the Nasdaq 0.8% to 25,981.57; the Hang Seng fell about 1.0% to 24,667 and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 0.6%. AP reported Brent settled at $108.75 per barrel (+2.9%), while the US 10-year Treasury yield rose to 5.00% after briefly touching 5.04% overnight. Apple released the next generation of Apple Intelligence and Siri AI, with an English beta beginning that day; it is not available in China and initial availability is also limited in some regions. TrendForce's September 15 spot quotes showed DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 up 0.12% to $54.40, DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 down 0.08% to $45.536, and DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 down 0.14% to $89.125.

label.zh: 油价与长端利率加剧估值压力
label.en: Oil and long yields intensify valuation pressure

title.zh: 利率站上 5% 时，增长与高估值资产对风险偏好的敏感度上升。
title.en: With long yields at 5%, growth and premium-valued assets become more sensitive to risk appetite.

detail.zh: 原油、长端利率和权益市场同步承压是已确认事实；将其解读为折现率约束是分析判断，并不预测货币政策、能源价格或企业盈利。
detail.en: Oil, long yields and equities all came under pressure as confirmed facts; reading this as a discount-rate constraint is analysis, not a forecast of policy, energy prices or earnings.

label.zh: 美国 10 年期国债收益率 · Sep 15

title.zh: 油价与长端利率继续压制美股估值
title.en: Oil and long yields keep pressuring US valuations

detail.zh: AP 报道布伦特原油上涨 2.9% 至 108.75 美元，10 年期美债收益率由前一日尾盘 4.97% 升至 5.00%、隔夜一度触及 5.04%。标普 500 下跌 34.25 点至 7,585.73；该组合提高估值敏感资产的波动风险，但不单独决定通胀或联储政策。
detail.en: AP reported Brent rose 2.9% to $108.75, while the 10-year Treasury yield climbed from 4.97% late Monday to 5.00% and briefly touched 5.04% overnight. The S&P 500 fell 34.25 points to 7,585.73; the combination raises volatility risk for valuation-sensitive assets but does not by itself determine inflation or Fed policy.

title.zh: 港股下跌，腾讯逆势上涨
title.en: Hong Kong falls while Tencent rises

detail.zh: RTHK 报道恒指收跌约 1.0% 至 24,667，科技指数下跌 0.6%；腾讯上涨近 2%。指数与单日股价表现不能替代对 0700.HK 经营指标或 9992.HK 海外执行的验证。
detail.en: RTHK reported the Hang Seng closed about 1.0% lower at 24,667 and the tech index fell 0.6%, while Tencent gained nearly 2%. Index and one-day share-price moves do not substitute for operating evidence at 0700.HK or for validating 9992.HK's overseas execution.

title.zh: Siri AI 开始 beta 推送，采用与地域覆盖仍待验证
title.en: Siri AI beta begins, while adoption and geographic reach remain unproven

detail.zh: Apple 宣布新一代 Apple Intelligence 与 Siri AI 当日上线，英语 beta 开始推送，并计划次月扩展更多语言。该事实把产品路径从发布推进到可用性测试；中国暂不可用，初期地区限制和后续采用、服务收入或换机周期仍需数据验证。
detail.en: Apple announced the next generation of Apple Intelligence and Siri AI became available that day, with an English beta beginning and more languages planned next month. This advances the product path from announcement to availability testing; it is not available in China, and initial regional limits plus later adoption, Services revenue or upgrade-cycle effects still require evidence.

title.zh: DRAM 现货小幅分化，不定义行业周期
title.en: DRAM spot pricing is mildly mixed and does not define the cycle

detail.zh: TrendForce 的 9 月 15 日现货页显示 DDR5 16Gb 上涨 0.12%，DDR4 8Gb 与 DDR4 16Gb 分别下跌 0.08% 和 0.14%。单日现货变化不是合约价格、HBM 盈利、出货或 DRAM 基金回报的替代指标。
detail.en: TrendForce's September 15 spot page showed DDR5 16Gb up 0.12%, while DDR4 8Gb and DDR4 16Gb fell 0.08% and 0.14%. One-day spot moves are not substitutes for contract pricing, HBM profitability, shipments or DRAM ETF returns.
